notes.title: Codex Update: Issue Resolved and Improved Experience
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We sincerely apologize for the issues you've encountered with the Codex in previous versions of the game. We understand how important it is to have a smooth and complete gaming experience, and we regret that the Codex was not functioning as it should.

After thorough review and extensive testing, we are pleased to announce that the Codex has been fully repaired and is now working perfectly! Below are the details of this update:

Improvements and Fixes


 Codex Repaired: We have resolved all the issues that were preventing the Codex from working correctly. Now, all item images are displayed properly, and you can access detailed descriptions for every item in the game.



 Complete Item Display: The Codex now shows all items available in the game, not just those in your inventory. This allows you to explore every detail of the game world, even for items you have yet to discover.



 Improved Interface: We've made some small optimizations to the Codex interface to make it more intuitive and enjoyable to use.


We want to thank you for your patience and understanding. We are committed to providing you with the best possible gaming experience and appreciate your continued support. Keep sending us your feedback and reports: together, we can make this game even better!

Thank you for your support and happy gaming!
